summary: Assess mortality assumptions, calculate pension liability sensitivities and compare longevity responses. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Managing pension longevity risk means assessing how longer lifetimes may change benefit cash flows, liabilities and funding decisions. For pension actuaries, risk analysts and scheme finance professionals, the course uses Excel exercises to check mortality experience, compare assumptions and interpret longevity scenarios. You will also calculate IAS 19 liability sensitivities and prepare decision material, with operational introductions to Lee-Carter and Cairns-Blake-Dowd methods.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review pension mortality assumptions, assess longer-life exposure or explain its effect on plan liabilities and decisions. It suits people with working familiarity with pension benefits, actuarial valuations or pension finance.
modules: Cohort Life Tables and Benefit Design
prerequisites: Working familiarity with pension plan benefits, liabilities or actuarial and finance terminology is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with a licensed Excel installation for the workbook exercises.
